scientific_integrity: Self-contained finite witness table and independently executable enumeration; unbounded extension uses a proved direct-product lemma.
scientific_limitations: Exact result is for matchings of exactly three edges per component of a disjoint union of eight-vertex paths; no statement for a single global quota or arbitrary graph. Independent validation and exhaustive priority search remain outstanding.
title: An unbounded VC–Littlestone gap in fixed-quota path matchings
